statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56865 is scoped to the golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog transparency-log tile verifier. The Snyk CLI vendors golang.org/x/mod only for module-file, module-path and semver parsing; the sumdb tile verifier is not linked into the shipped artifacts, so the vulnerable code is not present.

CVE-2026-56864 is scoped to the golang.org/x/mod/sumdb checksum-database client. The Snyk CLI vendors golang.org/x/mod only for module-file, module-path and semver parsing; the sumdb client is not linked into the shipped artifacts, so the vulnerable lookup code is not present.

CVE-2026-56865 affects golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog tileHashReader.ReadHashes. Scout's module-level findings come from /usr/bin/gh: the arm64 GitHub CLI 2.97.0 binary contains golang.org/x/mod@0.37.0 and the amd64 GitHub CLI 2.98.0 binary contains golang.org/x/mod@0.38.0. Direct inspection of both shipped binaries found linked golang.org/x/mod/semver and golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/note symbols, but no golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog or tileHashReader.ReadHashes symbols. The vulnerable tile-verification code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts.

CVE-2026-56864 affects golang.org/x/mod/sumdb Client.Lookup. Scout's module-level findings come from /usr/bin/gh: the arm64 GitHub CLI 2.97.0 binary contains golang.org/x/mod@0.37.0 and the amd64 GitHub CLI 2.98.0 binary contains golang.org/x/mod@0.38.0. Direct inspection of both shipped binaries found linked golang.org/x/mod/semver and golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/note symbols, but no golang.org/x/mod/sumdb client implementation or Client.Lookup symbols. The vulnerable Lookup code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts.
